{{Quote|Why you ''double-crossing''... Get ''back'' here, you ''Ruloosian sand-snake''!|[[Rarsk (Hutt)|Rarsk]], to a [[Han Solo/Legends|disguised]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="TCK" />}}
The '''Ruloosian sand-snake''' was a species from the [[Ruloosia system/Legends|Ruloosia system]].<ref name="Planetnamia" />

It was also a slang term used by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Rarsk (Hutt)|Rarsk]] in reference to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who tricked him and [[Bo-Dum]].<ref name="TCK" />
